messages:
Maya: Quick sync — locking webinar format. Topic: "Practical Inference Playbooks". Goal is buyer-ready narratives + reproducible benchmark snapshots. Need final abstracts (<=200 words), a benchmark slide with reproducible harness link, and rehearsal availability by Tue.
Ethan: Is the format still one stage or are we doing parallel breakouts?
Maya: One stage main talk (35m) + deep-dive breakout (20m) for engineers. Attendees choose breakout during registration.
Sofia: For abstracts, should we call out specific benchmark numbers?
Maya: Yes: include one quantitative datapoint (p50 latency or tokens/sec or $/1k tokens) and a 1-sentence method note (how the number was measured). Buyers care about reproducibility.
Liam: Rehearsal cadence idea: speaker run-through (30m) week-of + one full dress with breakouts (60m) two days prior. I can host the breakout tech check.
Maya: Good. OpsBot — can you create two rehearsal types: #speaker-run and #full-dress and auto-schedule when speakers post windows?
OpsBot: Yep. Post two preferred 90-minute windows and I will create Zoom + calendar invites with labels and attach the checklist. I will also publish an RSVP poll for breakout attendance.
Ethan: Checklist for speakers?
Maya: Minimal list: 1) abstract (<=200 words) with single benchmark datapoint, 2) 2-slide storyboard PDF (main slide + breakout notes), 3) reproducible harness link (git tag + seed prompts), 4) prompts.txt (3 prompts: nominal, long-input, fallback), 5) expected_outputs.txt (one example per prompt), 6) lightweight evals.csv (prompt, p50_tokens, p95_tokens, p50_ms, p95_ms, model_variant), 7) recorded short demo (mp4) for failover, 8) short bio + headshot. Deadline: Tue EOD.
Sofia: For prompts.txt format, we'll use plain lines and a comment for success criteria. Example in thread?
Maya: sure:
```
nominal: "Summarize this API changelog for PMs in 3 bullets"
long_input: "Changelog ~6k chars - extract top-3 impact items"
fallback: "If p95 latency >700ms use compact-infer and rerun"
# success criteria: 3 relevant bullets, no added features
```
Liam: Who flips the fallback live if we see latency? InfraBot or Ops?
InfraBot: Infra will monitor p95 and publish a green/yellow/red webhook. If red, OpsBot will switch source to recorded demo and ping the speaker channel.
Maya: Also routing for inbound leads: attendees who watch breakout + click demo link -> SDR queue-2. Attendees who just register -> nurture. Attendees who ask technical Qs and stay >20m -> pyro-sdr (high-priority). Please include a UTM scheme in your demo links so we can route.
Ethan: Polls to run? We should surface buyer intent quickly.
Sofia: propose 2 quick polls at start: 1) role (PM/Eng/Infra/Other) 2) biggest constraint (latency/cost/ops/other). Then a CTA poll mid-session: interested in pilot? (yes/no).
OpsBot: I will add poll templates to the runbook and attach to the calendar invites.
Liam: Failover runbook note: if live model stalls >8s/token or demo fails to return within 45s, OpsBot swaps to recorded demo and marks fallback_used in tracker. Speakers, include a 30s recorded fallback snippet and a 1-sentence intro to handoff.
Maya: Success metrics: registrant->attendee % (target 45%+), breakout opt-in %, live-demo-no-fallback % (target 93%+), pilot signups from attendees (target 30% of engaged), and benchmark reproducibility (we must be able to re-run harness and get within 10% of published number).
Ethan: How do we capture which model variant was used for each live demo?
Maya: include model_variant in evals.csv and infra will emit the per-run logs linked in the postmortem.
Sofia: I'll drop my abstract + harness link by Tue EOD and post two 90-minute windows for OpsBot.
OpsBot: When you post windows I will create events and return ICS + join links here. :thumbsup:
